changelog.entry: Teach the Machine now has an opening screen with Continue, New Game and Saves, a short skippable tutorial that you can bring back from the Tutorial button, and a keyboard help list on the ? key. Esc closes whatever is open, and Start over still asks before it clears anything.

The first three shelves of Teach the Machine: 24 lessons in Sorting Basics, Two Features and Distractions. You switch features on and off for Pip, a small sorting machine, press Train to grow its tree of questions, then Test it on cases it has never seen. Every wrong answer has a Why button that shows the exact questions the case went through and which of five kinds of mistake it was; each kind goes into your Failure Notebook the first time you find one. Every lesson was proved clearable, and the Distractions shelf starts with every switch on, where switching things off is the fix. Nothing is timed and nothing is lost.
